summary: Pre-application consultation ran in March-April 2026 with low developer-reported attendance. Once formal application 26/0136/IC was validated, public engagement rose sharply: the council portal displayed 1,456 comments on 3 September 2026. A local campaign, No AI Data Centres – Inverclyde, is opposing the proposal. Its concerns include replacement of the previously consented housing-led scheme, absence of an EIA, electricity demand, noise, jobs and transparency. The comments total does not reveal the objection/support split and should not be read as a public-opinion poll.
